context: Classify only the exact claim supplied. Return exactly {"claim_verified":true|false,"classification":"verified|partial|unverified|agent_reported"}.

cases.input: An evaluator attempted one cross-tenant repository clone in a live sandbox, captured phase Failed, and asserted that phase. The claim is: this one attempted cross-tenant clone was refused. No claim is made about every possible tenant or route.
The evaluator wrote marker value 7319, suspended the sandbox, resumed it, read back 7319, and asserted exact equality. The claim is: this marker survived this suspend/resume cycle.
A reviewer agent's PR says a benchmark measured 11 ms import time. No evaluator has collected its command output or rerun it. The claim is: 11 ms was independently verified.
Four synthetic command-output compression requests saved 52% input tokens. The claim is: the production coding workflow now uses 52% fewer total tokens end to end.
The independent runner captured exit 0 and 7 exact-answer assertions passing on a specified small workload. The claim is: those 7 assertions passed in that run, without any broader quality claim.
A run failed during a test stage. An operator changed its timeout and resumed it successfully. The claim is: the original command succeeded unattended without intervention.
